parallels.note: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

translations.web: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.
translations.bsb: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
translations.kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
translations.asv: even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that he is nigh, even at the doors.
